prompt: Evaluate this repository's Dockerfile and npm maturity and report findings with a score. Do not change anything.
setup: A package.json exists with an engines.node of '>=16' and no .nvmrc.
A Dockerfile uses 'FROM registry.example.com/node:18.19.0-alpine' and ends with 'CMD ["npm", "start"]'.
expected: The report lists the alpine base (dockerfile-nodejs-slim), the npm CMD (dockerfile-use-node-command), the v1 lockfile (lockfile-outdated-version), the missing .npmrc (setup-npmrc), and the missing .nvmrc (setup-nvmrc), each with file and line evidence.
A maturity score is shown as a percentage with the failing and relevant weight totals.
Findings are ordered by priority and kept separate from the score.
Fixable rules (dockerfile-nodejs-slim, setup-nvmrc) are offered as fixes only, not applied.
must_not: Modify any file or Git state during evaluation.
Run npm install, npm ci, docker build, or any project script.
Report a rule as passing that could not be evaluated.
Invent findings for rules whose preconditions do not hold.
